title: A product's adapter, .factory/adapter.json
description: What the factory needs to know of a product (incident-platform ADR-0060 D6, stage-4.md "4.3", backlog #0-275). Every field is required and no other is allowed. A command is a list of arguments, run without a shell; a path is relative to the product's root and never leaves it. The dispatcher reads this file, as a blob, from the base commit of its own clone of the product's main, never from a checkout nor from a task's branch, and checks every path it names against that base's tree: no symlink on the way or at it (backlog #0-278); the schema checks the spelling only. The product's commands run in the task container only, from the base's blobs of trustedPaths. Checked by dispatcher/src/schema/validate.mjs, which refuses any keyword it does not check.

repository.description: The product's repository on GitHub, owner/name (the name not . nor ..): where builder-app pushes and opens its pull requests.

gate.description: The product's test gate: the command, and the contract its JSON answer keeps (schemas/gate.schema.json).

changedPaths.description: The product's command that lists the paths a branch changes and classifies them (areas, rule files, reviewers): advisory, run in the task container, and no refusal of the dispatcher rests on it (backlog #0-278).

queue.description: Where the next item comes from: BACKLOG.md-style files until stage 7.

protectedPaths.description: The file that lists the product's protected paths.

trustedPaths.description: The product's paths that judge a task, which its branch may not change (a directory ends with /): the dispatcher refuses a branch that changes one, by its own check against the base's adapter, and puts the base's blobs of them into the task container before each command. Each command's script, and .factory/adapter.json itself, must lie under one of them (backlog #0-278).

taskImage.description: The product's task configuration, the devcontainer configuration written for the task container (incident-platform ADR-0062 points 4 and 6, backlog #0-277 AC5): a path in the product that never leaves it, not starting with - (it would read as an option), a .json. The dispatcher reads it from the base, checks it against its closed list, and builds the task image from it.

profile.description: The factory's profile for the product's stack (e.g. spring-boot).

factoryVersion.description: The factory's tag the product loads, vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.

path.description: A path relative to the product's root that never leaves it: not absolute, no .. segment (the lookahead reads across lines, [\s\S]), no backslash, and no control character nor line separator (U+0000-U+001F, U+007F, U+2028, U+2029).

script.description: The product's script a command runs: a path with at least one / (so never a program found on PATH, such as bash, env or node, however the command is run), not ending with / (a directory), and not starting with - (it would read as an option).

command.description: A command as its arguments, run without a shell: the first is the product's script, a path; the others any non-empty strings.
